entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Mediterranean Revival is an architectural style that incorporates traditional design aspects from the Mediterranean region, particularly Italy, Spain, southern France and Greece. The style includes influences from Spanish Renaissance, Spanish Colonial, Italian Renaissance, French Colonial, Beaux-Arts, Moorish, and Venetian Gothic architecture.
